name: Marxist-Leninist core ("tankies" proper)
what_it_is: Defends past and present one-party socialist states (USSR under Stalin, China, DPRK, Cuba, Vietnam) as real socialism and treats US-led capitalism as the main enemy. The group the word "tankie" originally named.
where_found: PSL, Workers World, FRSO; r/TheDeprogram, Lemmygrad, Hexbear; The Deprogram, Rev Left Radio, ProleWiki
marker_vocabulary: AES, CPC (not CCP), DPRK, critical support, revisionist, read theory, dialectical, "socialism with Chinese characteristics"
do_not_confuse_with: Trotskyists and anarchists, who use much of the same anti-capitalist language but attack these states

name: Maoist / Third-Worldist
what_it_is: Holds that workers in rich countries are bought off by imperial profits ("labor aristocracy") and that the US is an illegitimate settler state to be dismantled, not reformed.
where_found: Small party-building groups; "Settlers" (Sakai) reading circles; parts of Hexbear and X
marker_vocabulary: labor aristocracy, settler (as a class), amerikkka, imperial core, treats / treatlerite, people's war, MLM
do_not_confuse_with: Academic decolonial writers (DECOL), who share the settler-colonial frame without the Maoist program

name: Campist "anti-imperialist" media network
what_it_is: Journalists, outlets and NGOs whose common line is that US power is the root of each conflict and that states opposing the US deserve defense. Less about socialism than about geopolitics.
where_found: The Grayzone, Geopolitical Economy Report, MintPress News, BreakThrough News, Tricontinental, The People's Forum, CODEPINK, ANSWER Coalition
marker_vocabulary: multipolar world, unipolar hegemony, regime change, color revolution, NED-funded, manufacturing consent, proxy war, collective West
do_not_confuse_with: Realist scholars and antiwar liberals, who make some of the same factual points about US interventions without defending the other state

name: Resistance-axis solidarity strand
what_it_is: Treats Hamas, Hezbollah, the Houthis and Iran as one legitimate "resistance" to a US-Israeli order, and frames Israel as an outpost of US imperialism.
where_found: Samidoun, Within Our Lifetime, Palestinian Youth Movement, parts of campus encampment media
marker_vocabulary: the resistance, axis of resistance, Zionist entity, by any means necessary, glory to the martyrs, Al-Aqsa Flood, globalize the intifada
do_not_confuse_with: The much larger pro-Palestine public (ceasefire, aid, two-state or one-state advocates) who do not endorse the armed groups

name: Populist / "dirtbag" / streamer left
what_it_is: Online socialist commentary whose main target is the Democratic Party and liberals. Takes campist positions on some conflicts and not others; anti-liberal first, geopolitical second.
where_found: Chapo-lineage podcasts, Twitch and YouTube left streamers, r/Hasan_Piker, parts of DSA-adjacent media
marker_vocabulary: libs / shitlibs, Genocide Joe, blue MAGA, uniparty / duopoly, both parties are the same, vote blue no matter who (mocking), brunch
do_not_confuse_with: Progressive Democrats, who attack the party from inside and campaign for it in November

name: Decolonial / settler-colonial strand
what_it_is: Describes the US (also Canada, Australia, Israel) as an ongoing settler-colonial project on stolen land. Mostly academic and activist; most users are not campist.
where_found: University departments, land acknowledgments, Land Back campaigns, The Red Nation
marker_vocabulary: settler colonialism, Turtle Island, so-called United States, stolen land, land back, decolonize
do_not_confuse_with: ML and MLM, who borrow the vocabulary and add defense of rival states

name: Black radical anti-imperialist tradition
what_it_is: Sees US racism at home and US wars abroad as one system ("internal colony"); long-standing ties to Pan-Africanism and Cuba solidarity.
where_found: Black Alliance for Peace, African People's Socialist Party (Uhuru), Black Agenda Report
marker_vocabulary: AmeriKKKa, internal colony, AFRICOM, prison-industrial complex, political prisoners, US out of Africa

name: "Patriotic socialist" / MAGA-communist
what_it_is: Combines Marxist-Leninist symbols with nationalism, social conservatism and Duginist "multipolarity". Pro-Russia and pro-China, hostile to "globalists" and to the rest of the left.
where_found: American Communist Party (2024), Infrared, Center for Political Innovation
marker_vocabulary: MAGA communism, patriotic socialism, globalists, Atlanticists, multipolarity, Fourth Political Theory, de-dollarization
do_not_confuse_with: ML, who mostly reject them as "patsocs"; and RIGHT, with whom they share enemies

name: Isolationist / dissident right
what_it_is: Reaches several of the same foreign-policy conclusions (NATO provoked Russia, Ukraine is a proxy war, the US is run by a "regime") from nationalism, not socialism.
where_found: Tucker Carlson-style media, paleoconservatives, Groypers, parts of MAGA
marker_vocabulary: forever wars, deep state, the regime, GAE (global American empire), uniparty, America First, Israel First
do_not_confuse_with: Left campists: same sentences, different vocabulary around them (no "imperialism", "capital", "global south")

name: State media and officials of rival states
what_it_is: The official versions of these narratives: Russia (RT, Sputnik, TASS), China (CGTN, Global Times, Xinhua, MFA spokespeople), Iran (PressTV), Venezuela and Cuba (teleSUR).
where_found: RT, Sputnik, CGTN, Global Times, PressTV, teleSUR; embassy accounts
marker_vocabulary: special military operation, denazification, Kiev regime, collective West, Anglo-Saxons, golden billion, hegemon, Cold War mentality, century of humiliation, whole-process democracy
do_not_confuse_with: Western accounts quoting them to criticize them

name: Anti-campist far left (counter-class)
what_it_is: Socialists, Trotskyists and anarchists who call the US imperialist and also call Russia and China imperialist or authoritarian. They are the main false-positive risk for any "anti-American" keyword list.
where_found: WSWS, Tempest, New Politics, anarchist spaces, DSA Bread & Roses caucus, Ukraine Solidarity Network
marker_vocabulary: "neither Washington nor Moscow", campist (as an insult), tankie (as an insult), Stalinist, red fash, state capitalist
do_not_confuse_with: Everything above: they use "imperialism", "capital" and "ruling class" constantly

name: Ordinary criticism of the US (counter-class)
what_it_is: Liberals, conservatives and non-aligned people criticizing US policy, history or leaders. Includes calling a specific administration authoritarian or fascist.
marker_vocabulary: Iraq was a mistake, the US has a racism problem, Trump is a fascist, the healthcare system is broken
do_not_confuse_with: Everything above. None of this is anti-Western sentiment in the sense this lexicon tracks
